chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “A woman comes performing tamattuʿ, then menstruates before she performs tawaf of the House, and her becoming pure is on the night of ʿArafah.” So he عليه السلام said: “If she knows that she will become pure, perform tawaf of the House, come out of her ihram, and join the people at Minā, then let her do so.”

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: Around the Kaʿbah, the Sacred House
key_terms.طُهْرُهَا: Her state of becoming pure from menstruation

ai.seo_question: What should a woman performing tamattuʿ do if she menstruates before tawaf and becomes pure on the night of ʿArafah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman performing tamattuʿ hajj who menstruates before tawaf and becomes pure on the night of ʿArafah. The Imam عليه السلام states that if she expects to attain ritual purity in time to perform tawaf, exit ihram, and rejoin the pilgrims at Minā, then she should proceed in that manner.
